fields.field: DNP, land kept (Fab, 2026-09-12). DS41326 Table 2's 2 x 22 uF is the recommendation for the 2 A part at full load; Eq.10 at THIS board's ~3 mA wants 1.3 uF (0.3 A PFM peak, 50 mV overshoot) to 9.1 uF (0.8 A peak), and one 22 uF covers that. The land stays because C3/C4 carry no MPN yet and DC-bias derating is therefore UNKNOWN -- a heavily-derated 22 uF could approach the 9.1 uF floor, and on Path A this capacitance is also the first thing standing between the buck's PFM bursts and the AFE, which reaches it through R32. Populate C4 and C8 before reaching for a bead in R32. Check the chosen part's DC-bias curve against 9.1 uF at 3.3 V

fields.field: Local decoupling AT MCU VREF+ pin 5, which since 2026-09-12 is driven from /VREF_TRIM and not 3V3D. It FOLLOWED THE PIN rather than staying on 3V3D: its only reason to exist was that pin, and with pin 5 moved its bulk would otherwise be C10, 4.7 uF at U15 on the far side of the board. DS12232 Table 63 note 4 asks for a 100 nF specifically to cut high-frequency noise at this pin. 100n not 1u because the bulk is already at C10 and the total load on the REF3425 must stay inside SBAS804G's 0.1..10 uF stable range: 4.7 + 0.1 = 4.8 uF. 3V3D loses nothing -- C12, C13, C14, C11, C3, C20 and C21 are all still on it

fields.field: 3V3A rail monitor divider top leg, into MCU PA7/ADC_IN7. NOT 1:2 any more: R25 went 47k -> 27k on 2026-09-12, so the ratio is 27/74 and FIRMWARE is VA_MON_MV = ADC x 74/27 = 2.741 x ADC, derived by gen_hw_contract.py as O2P_HW_DIV_VA_NUM/DEN rather than written by hand. This IS the sourcing pass the old note asked for. The position was 0.1% 10k (P2TC0603D1002LNTA) only because R21/R22 once shared it, and those went with the trim and guard dividers. Nothing downstream SCALES by this reading -- it is rail health. The old note contrasted this pair with R34/R35, the 0.1% VREF_MON divider whose ratio main.c promoted into g_cyc.vref_mv: THAT DIVIDER IS DELETED and the reference is no longer measured at all, so the contrast no longer exists and this pair is simply the only rail divider left that needs no precision. 47k rather than 10k also drops the continuous draw on the analog rail feeding U4/U7 (U8 is deleted) from 165 uA to 35 uA. Source impedance went 5k -> 23.5k on that pass and is 17.2k today with the 27k bottom leg, and that is CHECKED, not assumed: ST DS12232 Table 59 (Maximum ADC RAIN) allows 50k at 12 bits and 160.5 sampling cycles, which is what mcu_adc.c already selects -- 2.9x margin at 17.2k (it was 2.1x at 23.5k), and more in practice because Table 59 is quoted at a 35 MHz ADC clock where this board runs 16 MHz. DO NOT RAISE THIS DIVIDER FURTHER: 100k legs would put the source at exactly the 50k limit. It releases the matched-pair placement adjacency the two-layer refloorplan work was holding

Source impedance also falls 23.5k -> 17.2k, further inside Table 59's 50k. FIRMWARE follows automatically: gen_hw_contract.py derives O2P_HW_DIV_VA_NUM/DEN from these two values

fields.field: REV B. The failsafe that makes the RE split SAFE, and it is the whole reason the split is not dangerous. RE is active low with a 2 MOhm internal pull-UP, so an undriven RE pin is a DISABLED receiver -- and every MCU GPIO is high-impedance out of reset. Without this resistor a probe that reset into the RS-485 bootloader (loader_main.c / loader_uart.c) would come up DEAF, destroying the field-reflash path SCHEMATIC-REVIEW.md M2 exists to provide. A potted probe would be unrecoverable. R45 makes receiver-enabled the passive default exactly as R7 makes driver-disabled the passive default. ARITHMETIC. Size against the GUARANTEED spec, not the 2 MOhm typical: SLLSEY3E gives IIN = +/-6.2 uA max for D, DE and RE over 3 V <= VCC <= 5.5 V, with VIL max 0.8 V. So the largest pull-down that still guarantees a low is R <= 0.8 V / 6.2 uA = 129k. 47k: worst case 6.2 uA * 47k = 291 mV, a 2.75x margin to VIL. (The 2 MOhm typical would give 76 mV, but a typical is not a guarantee and this pin must never come up deaf.) COST, stated plainly because it bounds the win this split was made for: commanding standby means DRIVING RE high, which pushes 3.3 V / 47k = 70.2 uA through R45. Standby is therefore ~70 uA, not the part's 0.1 uA. Against the 700 uA receiver that is still a 10x cut (630 uA saved), but it is NOT the 7000x the datasheet row promises, and at the duty-cycled floor of ~29 uA in POWER-BUDGET.md this resistor would be the single largest load on the board. WHY NOT A WEAKER PULL-DOWN: the 129k ceiling above means no resistor can better ~26 uA, so 220k/470k do not trade margin for microamps -- they are simply OUT OF SPEC (220k worst case = 1.36 V, 470k = 2.9 V, both above VIL). A resistor structurally cannot reach the 0.1 uA this split was made for; only omitting R45 and having the loader drive RE low early can, and that trades a sub-ms deaf window after reset. Fab chose 47k, 2026-09-07: robust, passive, no init-order dependency.

fields.field: Both halves are now unity-gain electrometer followers on the cell nodes: A buffers WE, B buffers RE and drives both the guard (through R40) and the ADC bias telemetry. Half A was freed by deleting the VREF trim divider. NO FEMTOAMPERE PART IS NEEDED HERE and this is the reason: SBOS351E gives OPA333 IB as +/-70 pA typ and +/-200 pA max at 25 C. MIND THE ARITHMETIC: IB is the AVERAGE of the two inputs, and a follower's electrode sees the non-inverting input alone, so the real bound is |IB| + |IOS|/2 = 200 + 200 = 400 pA. The RE node is ALREADY loaded by the LMP91000's own RE pin at +/-90 pA typ and +/-900 pA max over -40..80 C (SNAS506I IRE, TI's own front-page feature; at this board's 3.3 V the applicable column is nearer 800 pA). So half B takes RE's worst case from ~900 pA to ~1300 pA, +44%, and an ADA4530-1 at 20 fA would still leave ~900 pA and buy nothing. UNSTATED ASSUMPTION, flagged deliberately: SBOS351E gives NO max for IB over temperature, only +/-150 pA typ, so the claim that a chopper's charge-injection-dominated bias stays flat to 75 C rests on Figure 8, a typical curve, not a guaranteed limit. See POTTING.md section 1.3 under ../../../ha/farming/compostlab/o2-probe/

fields.field: 2.500 V series reference, REPLACING the AZ431 shunt and its R41/C9/R31 network. SBAS804G: +/-0.05% initial accuracy (max), 6 ppm/C max by the BOX method over -40..125 C -- which permits 990 ppm of TOTAL SPAN, not a 6 ppm/C local slope, so the bias contribution is ~0.9 mV and NOT the 0.3 mV a naive reading gives. 95 uA max Iq against the AZ431 network's 2.5 mA. Output +/-10 mA against this board's ~400 uA analog draw. IT IS NOT A 3-TERMINAL PART: pins are 1 GND_F, 2 GND_S, 3 EN, 4 IN, 5 OUT_S, 6 OUT_F and force/sense must BOTH be connected. EN IS TIED TO IN ON PURPOSE. Do not route it to a GPIO to make the rail gateable -- POWER-BUDGET.md invites exactly that, and dropping this rail drops the cell bias and restarts O2P_SETTLE_SECONDS = 900. Input is 3V3D and NOT +12V_SW: the board input is specified to 15 V and REF34's recommended input maximum is 12 V
